text:
sam: Hey folks — thinking of doing a casual office LAN + couch co-op evening next Friday (6pm). Low-key stream to the company Twitch for highlights. Who can bring capture gear / projector / extra controllers?
kelly: I can bring an Elgato HD60 S+ and a PS4 controller. :thumbsup:
mike: I have the spare projector and a long HDMI. Also an extension power strip.
ravi: I can bring an 8-port switch and a couple of Cat6 cables. Do we have enough power outlets near the couches?
sam: Good shout, mike — thanks. I'll grab a few power strips too.
ddeepa: Snacks? I volunteer to coordinate pizza and a veggie option. Who's in for +1s?
kelly: +1 for snacks. I can chip in $10.
mike: I'll bring my Nintendo Switch with Mario Kart and Smash. Also happy to run the lobby for match rotations.
sam: Game list idea: It Takes Two, Overcooked 2, L4D2 (classic), Mario Kart, Cuphead co-op run. Open to suggestions.
ravi: Throw in Rocket League for some quick rounds.
ddeepa: Love that. Also, can someone bring a spare HDMI->USB-C adapter? My Deck’s power cable is USB-C passthrough and I only have one.
kelly: I have a spare adapter — marked for checkout.
sam: Quick logistics block — please react to this thread: :joystick: if you're bringing a console, :pc: if bringing a PC/Steam Deck, :projector: for AV gear, :pizza: for food help.
ops-bot: Reminder: Please follow office guest policy if you're bringing non-employees. See <https://intranet.redwood/visitors>.
mike: For timing:
```
18:00 - doors/setup
18:30 - warmups & streamer test
19:00 - co-op rotation / matches
21:30 - wind down / free play
```
sam: If you want to host a mini-tourney, drop your team name below. I'm planning to stream highlights and maybe a silly MVP award.
ddeepa: Team "Snack Attack" (obvious choice)
ravi: Team "Packet Loss" doing Rocket League shenanigans. :joy:
kelly: Team "Joycon Jury" — Switch mains.
sam: Perfect. I'll post a final RSVP poll on Monday with a short sign-up. For now, just react and add gear notes. Thanks y'all :party_popper:
